title: Transfer of a Tor bound from the base to a localized polynomial ring
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring, n a natural number, p a prime of R=A[t₁,...,tₙ], S=R_p and M a finite S-module. Assume a natural d such that Tor_i^A(M,N)=0 for every A-module N and every i>d, for scalar restriction along A → R → S [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Then Tor_i^S(M,N)=0 for every S-module N and every i>d+n [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. The zero module, n=0 and d=0 are included.

proof.text: Restrict M to the polynomial ring P. Successive restriction to A is definitionally the restriction along the composite displayed in hTor. Apply lem-pc-polynomial-tor-bound to obtain vanishing over P above d+n for every P-module. For an S-module N take its P-restriction as test module, and apply lem-pc-tor-vanishing-localized-base to transfer this vanishing to S. No finite-generation condition on the P-restriction is needed.

proof_origin.document: C. Weibel, An Introduction to Homological Algebra; Stacks Project
proof_origin.place: Theorem 4.3.7 (polynomial step); Tag 0B67 (localization step), replacing the fibre argument of Tag 068X

theorem localizedPolynomial_tor_bound_of_base_tor_bound
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (n : ℕ) (p : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl))
    [Module.Finite (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl) M]
    (d : ℕ)
    (hTor : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} A, ∀ i : ℕ, d < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
            (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl)).comp MvPolynomial.C)).obj M)).obj N)) :
    ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl), ∀ i : ℕ, d + n < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) i).obj M).obj N)
